messages:
maria: kicking off the staggered v2 slice to eu-slice-3. quiet window 30m. putting a temporary cordon on the legacy-client header normalization.
kevin: thanks — what's the traffic plan? small steady steps? :eyes:
ashwin: plan is 5% -> 20% -> 50% over ~15m steps. we'll stop on any spike in 5xx or client errors.
olivia: noted. Add a rollback trigger: >0.6% client-schema errors (we saw weird deserializers last time).
maria: good call. adding to runbook. also flagging mobile-sdk pinned clients — if any pinned tenant hits 3% errors, pause progression.
sam: deploy-bot, please schedule the first slice now and post probe results.
deploy-bot: [deploy scheduled] "start_slice" initiated by sam for eu-slice-3 at 6868686868. Canary traffic: 5%.
ashwin: starting health probe sequence: curl -H 'Client-Version: v2' https://api.eu.redwood/v2/health -> expecting 200 and schema v2 in body
maria: pasting small config so ops knows exact gate: 
```
routes:
  - path: /v2
    traffic: 0.05
    header_gate: "client-version"
    fallback: "/v1"
    probe: "/health?schema=2"
```
kevin: quick question: are we normalizing header case at edge or leaving original client header?
ashwin: edge is preserving header case for now, we only match case-insensitively in routing. this avoids breaking clients that parse raw header bytes.
olivia: ops checklist updated with metrics to watch: token latency p50/p95, 5xx rate, client-schema-errors, mobile-pin-errors. thresholds in runbook.
sam: deploy-bot reported canary probe ok after 2m. can we nudge to 20%?
deploy-bot: [canary update] traffic moved to 20% at 6868686888. All canary probes green.
maria: slow push to 50% next if no anomalies for 10m. team eyes on mobile telemetry. :thumbsup:
kevin: logging snippet from proxy showing header handling: 
```
I0312 10:12:40 proxy.go:212] incoming headers: {"Client-Version":"v2","User-Agent":"mobile/4.2"}
```
ashwin: seeing a small uptick in client-schema-errors from a handful of tenants (0.18%). still below threshold. tracking.
olivia: if that drifts to >=0.6% in next 5m we pause and roll back to 5% and open a hotpatch.
sam: deploy-bot, mark operator handback ETA in 12m if stable.
deploy-bot: [operator-handback] scheduled at 6868686930 unless paused.
maria: filed a quick note for release-notes: remind partners about header matching behavior and client pin caveats.
kevin: one more: telemetry shows a spike in p95 for embedding calls — unrelated but could confuse our alerting. silencing embedding p95 for this window.
ashwin: agreed, muting that alert for 20m.
maria: 10m into 20% and metrics look steady. proceeding to 50% in 3m if no red flags.
ashwin: mobile-pin list check: none of the pinned tenants are impacted above 0.3%.
olivia: ops eyes remain on client-schema-errors and mobile-pin-errors.
deploy-bot: [traffic update] traffic moved to 50% at 6868686920. Canary -> slice steady.
maria: handing back to ops, leaving the cordon in place for one more hour. if anything odd, ping here and we roll back to 5% immediately. :rotating_light:
kevin: thanks all, good run.
ashwin: nice and smooth. I'll keep the debug logs for 2h in case we need them.
olivia: closing my watch in 60m unless an alert opens.
sam: thumbs up — operator handback acknowledged. :white_check_mark:
